mapper.insert: insert into ingestion_jobs ( id, original_filename, minio_object_key, status, total_chunks, error_message, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{job.id, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{job.originalFilename}, #{job.minioObjectKey}, #{job.status}, #{job.totalChunks}, #{job.errorMessage}, #{job.createdAt}, #{job.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, original_filename, minio_object_key, status, total_chunks, error_message, created_at, updated_at from ingestion_jobs where id = #{jobId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
select id, original_filename, minio_object_key, status, total_chunks, error_message, created_at, updated_at from ingestion_jobs order by created_at desc
select id, original_filename, minio_object_key, status, total_chunks, error_message, created_at, updated_at from ingestion_jobs where status = #{status} order by created_at desc
